org: The Media School, Indiana University Bloomington
name: IU Cinema Academy
what_you_do: A week on the IU campus making films. You try filmmaking, script writing, animation, video editing and acting for the camera. Teachers and film guests lead the sessions.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 18. The page has a star by this, so check the session page for exceptions.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the pages read. Three kinds of scholarships are offered.
duration: 1 week for most sessions; the Advanced Filmmakers Academy is 2 weeks
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran July 6 to 24. The Media School lists 2027 sessions for June and July (various weeks). No deadline stated.
how_to_apply: Fill in the form. It is on the Cinema Academy summer sessions page.
notes: There is also a one-week Online Filmmaking Bootcamp. The Media School also holds a free one-day teen workshop on Saturday Nov 14, 2026 (Cinema, Game Dev and Journalism tracks).
